subject: Intercompany PO routing & VAT split — supplier enrollment checklist
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@heliosys.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helio Systems AP <ap@heliosys.com>, procure@heliosys.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:12:00 +0100
Subject: Supplier enrollment — multi-entity PO routing & VAT split

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — Helio is replatforming AP flows and we need Redwood set up as a supplier across two legal entities in our EMEA cluster. The main asks from our side: 

- We require PO routing that can split a single PO across two Helio legal entities (Helio UK Ltd and Helio EU Services SARL) for VAT reclaim purposes.
- Every invoice must include: our PO number, your legal entity name and VAT ID, invoice-level breakdown showing which line items map to which Helio entity, and the supplier remit details.
- We need either a formatted XML sample (we attached a sample PO) or a CSV mapping file for our ingestion.
- Any requests for self-billing or special tax treatment require pre-approval; please include your VAT certificates and legal entity docs.

Attached: Helio_AP_Requirements.pdf (high-level spec) and Sample_PO_4207.xml (example PO with split lines).

Could you confirm Redwood's legal entity names, VAT IDs, and the bank remit instructions you want us to use? Also flag any known self-bill exceptions. We have a deadline of May 10 to complete supplier provisioning for the pilot.

Thanks —
Elena Cruz
Procurement Manager, Helio Systems
[Attachment: Helio_AP_Requirements.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]
[Attachment: Sample_PO_4207.xml (XML, 6 KB)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@heliosys.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment — multi-entity PO routing & VAT split

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear spec. We can support intercompany PO split routing but will need to confirm a couple of internal mappings. Quick answers up front:

- Redwood legal entities we will register: Redwood Inference Ltd (UK) — VAT GB999888000, and Redwood Inference EU SARL (LU) — VAT LU12345678.
- Our preferred remit: Redwood Inference Ltd (for GBP/EUR via UK bank) and Redwood Inference EU SARL (for EUR via our Luxembourg entity). Bank details attached (Redwood_Bank_Details.pdf).
- We can produce XML/CSV sample exports — Marcus, can you generate a CSV mapping that matches Helio's sample schema?
- On self-billing: we do not typically request self-billing but can accept it for pilot with a documented exception and a signed agreement (DocuSign preferred).

Action items:
1) Marcus — build the CSV mapping and include column-level mapping for PO-line -> Helio entity id.
2) Karthik — please confirm whether the Dedicated account tokenization flow will allow two remit endpoints under the same supplier ID for Helio.
3) Laura — prep the supplier packet with VAT certs and entity registry docs to attach to Helio's portal.

Elena, I will also share a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to track the provisioning steps and the May 10 cutover.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Bank_Details.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:17:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment — multi-entity PO routing & VAT split

Adding the CSV mapping stub (see inline example below) — I matched fields to Helio's Sample_PO_4207.xml: PO_NUM, LINE_ID, ITEM_DESC, QTY, PRICE, HELIO_ENTITY_ID, AMOUNT, TAX_RATE.

Sample row: 4207, 1, "Inference runtime hours", 100, 0.50, EU-01, 50.00, 20%

Notes:
- We will populate HELIO_ENTITY_ID using Helio's codes (EU-01 for SARL, UK-02 for UK Ltd) so their ingestion can split accordingly.
- Our billing system can emit an invoice-level JSON with line-to-entity mapping and a plain CSV for portal upload.
- Regarding tokenization: Karthik — be aware we need two remit endpoints on the same supplier account because accounting wants consolidated vendor history. If the portal forces separate supplier IDs, we'll need a cross-reference file.

I'll push the CSV sample to the Drive folder and post the link.

—Marcus
Senior Billing Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mapping_example.csv (CSV, 2 KB)]

From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@heliosys.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helio Systems AP <ap@heliosys.com>, procure@heliosys.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment — multi-entity PO routing & VAT split

Naomi / Marcus —

This looks good, thanks. A few items before May 10: 

- Please upload the CSV mapping to the Drive folder and we will validate.
- We can accept a single supplier record with a cross-reference file (preferred) — just ensure the PO XML includes HELIO_ENTITY_ID on each line.
- DocuSign: I'll send an exception form for self-billing later today (expect envelope link).
- Please include your VAT certificate for Redwood Inference EU SARL — we couldn't find it in the packet you uploaded (Laura, can you double-check?).

We'll start provisioning on our side once the CSV is validated. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
Elena Cruz
Procurement Manager, Helio Systems
[Attachment: Helio_Onboarding_Notes.txt (TXT, 1 KB)]
